name: Remich in a day
description_md:
Remich in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in LU. The trail covers a distance of 5.0 km.

The walking time for this route is about 6.3 hours based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This path is designated as a waymarked hiking route.
